title: Group OPS — Project Request / Project Issue
description: Contract between the OPS frontend (app/ops) and the backend. TypeScript mirror: app/ops/types.ts. Endpoints: see $comment on each definition.

Status.description: Lifecycle of a project request or an issue. Open = submitted, awaiting review · To-Do = accepted, queued · In Progress = being worked on · Review = delivered, waiting for someone to check it (the result is recorded in `review`; the team then moves the status) · Done = closed by the team · Reject = declined (see status_history remark).

Review.description: Latest review outcome on a project or issue.

ReviewInput.$comment: POST /api/ops/projects/{project_id}/review or /api/ops/issues/{issue_id}/review → Project | ProjectIssue. Allowed only while status = Review, for ANY signed-in user. Records `review` only — the status does NOT change; the OPS team moves the item (PATCH .../status) after reading the result. A review older than the latest move into Review belongs to an earlier round and is ignored by the UI.

ProjectId.description: Generated by the backend on create.

IssueId.description: Generated by the backend on create.

Person.description: Snapshot of the user at the time of the action. The backend fills it from the session (employee_id) — the client never sends it.

Attachment.$comment: Upload: POST /api/ops/attachments (multipart: ref_type, ref_id, file) → Attachment. Called once per file after the request/issue is created.

remark.description: Required by the backend when status = Reject

ProjectRequestInput.$comment: POST /api/ops/projects (application/json) → 201 { project_id }. Field numbers match the Request-Project-OPS form (1–8). #8 attachments are uploaded separately.

Project.$comment: GET /api/ops/projects?scope=mine|all&status=<Status> → Project[] · GET /api/ops/projects/{project_id} → Project · PATCH /api/ops/projects/{project_id}/status { status, remark? } → Project · PATCH /api/ops/projects/{project_id}/plan PlanInput → Project · PATCH /api/ops/projects/{project_id}/assignees AssignInput (not when Done/Reject) → Project. Management calls: OPS team (AssignInput usernames) / admin only, on every project. Anyone else signed in may read, create requests/issues, comment and review

assignees.description: OPS team members, multi-select; assigned while status = Open. Allowed usernames: see $defs.AssignInput

planned_start.description: Gantt bar start — set by admin when the request is accepted (To-Do). null = not planned yet

planned_end.description: วันที่คาดว่าจะเสร็จ — set by the assignee / OPS team from the detail sheet. planned_end < today and status != Done → overdue

status_history.description: Oldest first; first entry is Open at created_at

link_url.description: ลิงก์ใช้งานระบบ (http/https) — set via $defs.LinkInput once Done

ProjectTitleInput.$comment: PATCH /api/ops/projects/{project_id}/title → Project. OPS team / admin, or anyone with can_edit (403 otherwise); any status except Done (409). The title is trimmed (min 3) and copied onto the project's tasks.

LinkInput.$comment: PATCH /api/ops/projects/{project_id}/link → Project. OPS team / admin only (403), status = Done only (409). url must be http(s) with a host (400); null or "" removes it.

ProjectEditInput.$comment: PATCH /api/ops/projects/{project_id} → Project. Send only the fields being changed (same rules as ProjectRequestInput; only user_groups / target_date may be null). Not when Done/Reject (409). Who: requested_by.employee_id = "system" (imported by the system) → the project's assignees; otherwise the requester and anyone whose department equals requested_by.department (403 for others). A new title is copied onto the project's tasks.
ProjectEditInput.description: Any non-empty subset of ProjectRequestInput's properties.

StatusInput.$comment: Body of PATCH /api/ops/projects/{project_id}/status and PATCH /api/ops/issues/{issue_id}/status — sent when a card is dragged to another column. Appends a StatusChange.

PlanInput.$comment: Body of PATCH /api/ops/projects/{project_id}/plan (OPS team / admin; not allowed when Done or Reject). Send only the fields being changed; null clears.

AssignInput.$comment: Body of PATCH /api/ops/projects/{project_id}/assignees. Replaces the whole list; [] clears it.

ProjectIssueInput.$comment: POST /api/ops/issues (application/json) → 201 { issue_id }. #3 attachments are uploaded separately.

project_id.description: 1. โปรเจค (Project ID) ที่พบปัญหา

description.description: 2. รายละเอียดปัญหาที่พบ

examples.description: กดบันทึกใบงานแล้วขึ้น Error 500 ทุกครั้งที่แนบรูปเกิน 2 รูป คาดว่าควรบันทึกได้ตามปกติ

ProjectIssue.$comment: GET /api/ops/issues?scope=mine|all&project_id=&status= → ProjectIssue[] · PATCH /api/ops/issues/{issue_id}/status { status, remark? } (OPS team / admin) → ProjectIssue

project_assignees.description: Denormalised from the project's current assignees (the people who fix the issue)

TaskId.description: Generated by the backend on create.

ProjectTaskInput.$comment: POST /api/ops/tasks → 201 ProjectTask. OPS team / admin only, while the project is not Reject (Done is allowed, for follow-up fixes on a delivered system); owner = the session user. The task starts at status Open.

project_id.description: โปรเจกต์หลักที่ Task นี้สังกัด

due_date.description: กำหนดเสร็จ; due_date < today and status not Done/Reject → overdue

ProjectTask.$comment: GET /api/ops/tasks?scope=mine|all&project_id= → ProjectTask[] (scope=mine: session user is owner or assignee) · PATCH /api/ops/tasks/{task_id} TaskEditInput (title: not when Done; project_id: only while Open) → ProjectTask · PATCH /api/ops/tasks/{task_id}/status { status } (remark optional, Reject = cancelled) → ProjectTask · PATCH /api/ops/tasks/{task_id}/assignees AssignInput (not when Done/Reject; owner is never in the list) → ProjectTask · PATCH /api/ops/tasks/{task_id}/plan TaskPlanInput (not when Done/Reject) → ProjectTask. All task changes above: OPS team / admin, on every task. Note + pictures — owner / co-assignees / admin, not when Done (can_note): PATCH /api/ops/tasks/{task_id}/note TaskNoteInput → ProjectTask · POST /api/ops/tasks/{task_id}/attachments multipart { file } (images only, max 10) → 201 Attachment · DELETE /api/ops/tasks/{task_id}/attachments/{attachment_id} → ProjectTask

assignees.description: Co-assignees added by the owner until Done/Reject (owner excluded). Allowed usernames: see $defs.AssignInput

can_note.description: Viewer is the owner / a co-assignee / admin and the task is not Done

TaskNoteInput.$comment: Body of PATCH /api/ops/tasks/{task_id}/note. Empty or null clears it.

TaskEditInput.$comment: Body of PATCH /api/ops/tasks/{task_id}. OPS team / admin: title until Done; project_id only while the task is Open. project_id must be a project that is not Reject; the response carries the new project_title.

TaskPlanInput.$comment: Body of PATCH /api/ops/tasks/{task_id}/plan. null clears the due date.

CommentInput.$comment: POST /api/ops/projects/{project_id}/comments or /api/ops/issues/{issue_id}/comments → 201 Comment. Author comes from the session.

Comment.$comment: GET /api/ops/{projects|issues}/{id}/comments → Comment[] (oldest first) · PATCH /api/ops/comments/{comment_id} CommentInput → Comment (author only; sets edited_at) · DELETE /api/ops/comments/{comment_id} → 204 (author only; its likes go with it) · PUT /api/ops/comments/{comment_id}/like → LikeState · DELETE /api/ops/comments/{comment_id}/like → LikeState. One like per user per comment.

edited_at.description: Last edit by the author; null = never edited

ApiError.description: Any 4xx/5xx body. field_errors keys are input property names.
